subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR that applies the sidebar image sizing parity fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the source-visible CSS mismatch, but an open fork PR already owns the narrow fix path and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not open another repair PR or close the issue before a maintainer chooses the path.

options.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
options.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof, then close this issue.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author for fresh proof and an updated, maintainer-reviewable branch.

options.title: Reject the parity fix
options.body: Keep this issue open only if maintainers decide the oversized image symptom needs a different proven root-cause fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
recommendation.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof, then close this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored and merged the PR that introduced the current image sizing rules and is the clearest routing candidate for the UI styling decision.
